messages:
anya: Quick sync — Legal signed off on the updated offboarding data retention rules. Need to finalize handbook copy, manager comms, and the short mandatory microtraining process.

miguel: Nice. High level: personal account data removed within 30 days unless on legal hold; diagnostics/backups/logs retained up to 12 months only for investigations; device images purged unless explicit consent+mgr signoff.

julie: I can write the handbook blurb. Should we include an opt-in checkbox for short-term investigatory retention?

miguel: Yes — proposed checkbox text: "I consent to temporary retention of account logs and backups for security investigations (up to 12 months)." Keep it short.

olivia: Operational note: I need the exact fields we must export before deprovisioning so hiring/offboarding scripts can snapshot. Typical CSV columns: name,email,employee_id,primary_repo_access,last_login,personal_device_serial,manager.

sam: Managers: remember there will be a 15-min exit microtraining covering item pickup, return logistics, and how to present retention choices. We want managers to complete/watch within 7 days of any exit.

anya: Plan: publish handbook update tomorrow morning, post manager brief + 2-slide checklist, record a 15-min training video and require manager acknowledgement. Olivia will run an export 24h before deprovisioning.

julie: Draft handbook paragraph: "When an employee leaves Redwood, personal account data will be deleted within 30 days, except when legal holds or active security investigations require retention. Backups and logs may be retained for up to 12 months strictly for investigatory purposes. Employees will be offered an opt-in consent for short-term investigatory retention. Managers will receive a checklist and must complete the short exit microtraining." Thoughts?

miguel: Looks good. Add links to the detailed retention policy and the e-sign consent form. Also call out how to request a legal hold.

olivia: Internal links: offboarding checklist + opt-in form -> https://redwood.internal/offboard/checkout  form id OFF-2026-07. Export CLI example for infra:
```
# generate offboard snapshot for user 2048
redwood-admin export --user 2048 --fields name,email,employee_id,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-2048.csv
```

sam: Can HR have a small tracking sheet for manager training completions + consent opt-ins? We should record manager name, employee id, opt-in Y/N, training watched Y/N.

anya: Yes — I'll publish the CSV tracker and the acknowledgement flow. Will include a manager checklist (keys: confirm device return, run export, present consent form, complete e-sign).

julie: I'll post the handbook draft in #people-ops-docs for review and include the opt-in wording + link to form.

hr-bot: Reminder created — publish handbook update to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager training recording for 2026-04-01 10:00 PT.

olivia: One operational ask: please confirm retention clock starts at employee termination date, not deprovisioning date, so exports happen before termination effective date where possible.

anya: Confirmed. Retention window starts at termination date. Will add to handbook FAQ (Q: When does retention start?).

julie: Great — I'll iterate and post in the docs channel. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks — I'll follow up with the tracking sheet once published.
